name: Balatro: crash
description: A Balatro session crashed (app.crash from the otel-trace mod). The event has the exception message and stack trace; follow $trace_id to the run it interrupted.
ai_report_instructions: Show the app.crash event's exception message, stack trace, game state and run seed. Follow its $trace_id in the .traces/balatro dataset to the failed balatro.run / balatro.blind / balatro.hand spans, and list the log records (mod errors, app.jank) of the same $session.id in the minutes before the crash.
